name: Temporary Residence -- Studying

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmation of enrollment at a higher education institution accredited by the Serbian Ministry of Education.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission and enrollment confirmation from an accredited Serbian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of subsistence for the duration of study.
Proof of health insurance valid in Serbia.

evidence_required.document: Enrollment confirmation from an accredited institution
Valid personal/travel document, photo, residential address registration

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable for the duration of study
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: counts toward permanent residence's 3-year continuous-residence requirement if approved on the basis of temporary residence

sources.title: Serbian Ministry of Interior (MUP) -- Temporary residence grounds, including studying: requires confirmation of enrollment at a Ministry of Education-accredited institution, plus proof of subsistence and health insurance; also covers schooling, Serbian language courses, student/pupil exchange, and scientific research as separate education-based grounds

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). Modeled around the general study ground; MUP's page also lists schooling, Serbian-language-course attendance, student/pupil exchange programs, and scientific research as distinct education-related grounds under the same general 'up to 3 years' temporary residence framework, not modeled as separate files here to avoid near-duplicate routes. work_rights modeled 'none' since MUP's study ground did not describe any work authorization bundled with the student permit (unlike some other countries in this dataset); no explicit part-time-work allowance was found in the tier-1 material reviewed. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects the statutory 3-year domicile figure in the Law on Citizenship (see rs_naturalisation.json) rather than a study-specific track -- disclosed there that the practical total timeline is described by tier-3 sources as longer in most cases.
